why: Body only asserts os.path.exists on plan_b1.jsonl and plan_b2.jsonl; no helper, content, command or value check. Empty touched files pass. Other tests check input hashes, schema and cost thresholds.
One Path('/app/image.c').exists() assertion; no helper or content read, so an empty touched file passes. Other tests compile it, size-check it and run a 0.99 similarity check.

One Path('/app/convert_masks.py').exists() assertion; no helper or content read, so an empty touched file passes. test_run_script and csv/IoU tests check content. test_csv_output_exists is presence-only too.
One Path('/app/my_warrior.red').exists() assertion; an empty touched file passes. The real check is test_warrior_performance, which runs pmars against the win-rate thresholds.
